items.title: 2027: APC aspirant sues party, INEC over Abia South ticket
items.description: By Ugochukwu Alaribe UMUAHIA — An aspirant for the Abia South Senatorial District seat on the platform of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Erondu Uchenna Erondu Jnr, has dragged the party and the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) before the Federal High Court, Abuja, over the alleged substitution of his name as the party’s candidate. Erondu Jnr, who currently represents Obingwa West State Constituency in the Abia State House of Assembly, is challenging the purported substitution of his name as the APC’s flag bearer for the 2027 senatorial election. The suit followed reports that the APC had replaced him with Prince Paul Ikonne as its candidate for the senatorial district. Erondu insists that he remains the duly elected candidate of the party, having emerged from the APC’s direct primary held on May 18, 2026. The lawmaker said the outcome of the primary was upheld by the party’s Appeal Committee and further supported by an Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) Certified True Copy of the primary election report. Erondu argued that his nomination could not lawfully be substituted, stressing that he had neither died nor voluntarily withdrawn from the race, while no court order had removed him as the APC’s candidate for Abia South Senatorial District. Court documents sighted by Vanguard showed that Erondu instituted Suit No. FHC/ABJ/CS/1803/2026 at the Federal High Court, Abuja Division, against the APC, INEC, Prince Paul Ikonne, Dr Nyerere Chinenye Anyim and Mrs Blessing Nwagba. The matter is before Justice M. G. Umar. In an order dated July 28, 2026, the court granted Erondu leave to serve the originating summons and accompanying processes on the third, fourth and fifth defendants by substituted means. The order directed that the court processes be served by delivering them to a staff member or any person at the APC National Secretariat, located at 40 Blantyre Street, Wuse 2, Abuja, or by affixing them at the entrance gate of the premises. The court held that such service would be deemed good and sufficient on the affected defendants. The case was adjourned to September 9, 2026, for further proceedings. The post 2027: APC aspirant sues party, INEC over Abia South ticket appeared first on Vanguard News .

ASUU indefinite strike grounds Nasarawa varsity over unpaid N3bn entitlements
items.description: By Edwin Philip, Lafia LAFIA — Academic activities have been grounded at the Nasarawa State University, Keffi (NSUK), following the declaration of a total, comprehensive and indefinite strike by the Academic Staff Union of Universities (ASUU), NSUK chapter, over alleged unpaid entitlements amounting to more than N3 billion. The Chairman of the union, Dr Zubairu Loko, announced the decision on Monday after an emergency meeting of the chapter, stating that the action was in line with resolutions reached at the last National Executive Council (NEC) meeting of the union held in July. He listed the outstanding arrears to include Earned Academic Allowance (EAA), consequential adjustment arising from the implementation of the national minimum wage, and the Federal Government-approved salary increment for university lecturers. The ASUU chapter chairman accused the university management and the Nasarawa State Government of insensitivity to the welfare of its members despite several engagements. He added that the union had held a series of meetings with the university management, the Governing Council and the state government to resolve the issues without success. “Enough is enough. We have withdrawn our services. There will be no teaching, no supervision, no research until our money is paid,” Loko declared. He threatened that members of the union would not return to the classrooms until all outstanding entitlements were fully cleared. The post ASUU indefinite strike grounds Nasarawa varsity over unpaid N3bn entitlements appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Última hora del terremoto en Colombia, en directo | Al menos 25 muertos por el terremoto de magnitud 7,4 en Colombia
items.description: Al menos 25 personas han muerto en Colombia por el terremoto de magnitud 7,4 que ha sacudido el oeste del país este lunes a las 7.34 de la mañana, hora local, según las primeras cifras comunicadas por los alcaldes de Pereira, Manizales y Buenaventura. Las sacudidas han derrumbado varias decenas de edificios y han causado heridos en el departamento de Chocó, uno de los más afectados hasta el momento. También ha habido graves destrozos en la ciudad de Cali, donde el alcalde, Alejandro Eder, ha comunicado que al menos 25 estructuras se han derrumbado “con personas atrapadas”. “He solicitado ayuda a Bogotá y Medellín para que manden rescatistas”, ha escrito Eder en un mensaje en su cuenta de X, en el que pide a la ciudadanía “mantener la calma y salir de los edificios” si ven grietas grandes. items.title: Mauritanie : démantèlement d’un réseau de trafiquants à Akjoujt et déferment de personnes soupçonnées devant les autorités judiciaires
items.description: Les autorités mauritaniennes ont déféré devant les autorités judiciaires compétentes plusieurs personnes soupçonnées de trafic de stupéfiants et de substances psychotropes, après leur arrestation lors d'opérations qui ont permis de démanteler plusieurs réseaux de trafic et de saisir des quantités de différentes sortes de ces substances, selon la Gendarmerie nationale. Le commandant Mohamed Ould Dedda, représentant de la Gendarmerie nationale chargé de la formation, a déclaré que ces opérations s’inscrivent dans le cadre du plan national de sécurité pour la lutte contre les stupéfiants et les substances psychotropes, qui repose sur une approche combinant action sécuritaire, sensibilisation, formation et renforcement de la coordination entre les différentes parties prenantes. Les déclarations de Ould Dedda ont été faites lors d’une session de formation organisée par le ministère de l’Autonomisation des jeunes, de l’Emploi, des Sports et de la Fonction publique, en collaboration avec le commandement de la Gendarmerie nationale, à laquelle ont participé 100 jeunes de la wilaya d’Inchiri, sous le slogan « Des jeunes sans drogue ». Par ailleurs, la gendarmerie a annoncé le démantèlement d’un réseau actif dans la vente et la distribution de stupéfiants et de substances psychotropes dans la ville d’Akjoujt, ainsi que l’arrestation de ses principaux membres, lors d’une opération sécuritaire conjointe menée par des unités des compagnies d’Akjoujt et de Nouakchott n° 1. La gendarmerie a indiqué dans un communiqué publié ce lundi que l’opération, menée par la compagnie d’Akjoujt représentée par son détachement en ville, en coordination avec la compagnie de Nouakchott n° 1 représentée par le détachement des enquêtes judiciaires, a permis de saisir 1 246 comprimés d’ecstasy, qualifiés dans le communiqué de « très dangereux », ainsi qu’une quantité de résine de cannabis, connue localement sous le nom de « pierre noire ».

items.title: Peshawar High Court grants transit bail to Noreen Niazi in Peca case
items.description: PESHAWAR: The Peshawar High Court (PHC) on Monday granted transit bail to Noreen Niazi, the sister of incarcerated PTI founder Imran Khan, in a case registered under the Peca Act 2016, directing her to appear before the relevant Islamabad court on or before August 20. In July, the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency (NCCIA) registered a case against Noreen, accusing her of passing derogatory and inflammatory remarks against state institutions during a podcast interview and in subsequent clips shared on X. A single-member PHC bench comprising Justice Arshad Ali heard Noreen’s petition, represented by a panel of lawyers, including Ali Zaman, Amir Zeb and Barrister Sarwar Muzaffar Shah In its order issued on Monday, the bench stated that the petitioner had approached the court seeking transit bail in connection with a first information report (FIR) registered against her at the NCCIA police station in Islamabad on July 27 under various provisions of the Peca Act 2016 and the Pakistan Penal Code, enabling her to approach the competent court. The order noted that the petitioner had claimed to have been falsely implicated in the case and that, except for the bare allegations contained in the FIR, there was no other cogent evidence on record to connect her with the alleged offence. “In the circumstances of the case, the petitioner’s request, being reasonable, merits consideration,” the order noted, adding that “consequently this application is accepted and the accused petitioner is granted ad-interim transit pre-arrest bail provided she furnishes bail bonds in the sum of Rs80,000 with two sureties,” it said. The bench also directed the petitioner to approach the competent forum in Islamabad for bail on or before August 20, as the PHC order would be effective till that day. Meanwhile, the counsels for the petitioner argued that their client was innocent and falsely implicated in the case registered at the NCCIA police station. They said the local police were trying to arrest their client with mala fide intentions, to humiliate and unjustly harass her for some ulterior motive. The counsels also said the allegations contained in the FIR were false and politically motivated, and were based on an erroneous interpretation of statements allegedly attributed to their client. Talking to reporters after the hearing, Noreen said she came to know about the NCCIA case against her after arriving in Peshawar. “I did speak inside in my house, which I do not have recollection of, and someone got that to them and they made a case against me,” she claimed. Noreen further alleged that cases had been lodged against her other sisters and that now one had been registered against her as well. “Too many cases are being registered across Pakistan, and no one knows why they have been lodged. The case against me is the same,” she said. In response to a question, she said they had never been to Peshawar, so the question of their interfering in KP affairs did not even arise. Earlier, the Lahore High Court had also granted her an interim protective bail, directing her to approach a relevant Islamabad court. Before registering an FIR, the NCCIA had summoned Noreen to appear before it on July 20 over allegations of disseminating “false, offensive and inflammatory” content against state institutions. While the notice did not specify the content in relation to which Noreen has been summoned, it was issued after the clip of her making claims in relation to last year’s brief military conflict between Pakistan and India was widely shared on social media. In the clip, she is seen alleging during an interview that the conflict was “orchestrated” to improve the image of Pakistan’s military. She claimed the “drama” was played out in collaboration with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, questioning why Modi would have refrained from further attacking Pakistan otherwise. In this connection, she went on to allege that the objective was to get Israel recognised by Pakistan, linking US President Donald Trump’s praise of Pakistan’s leadership with Israel’s recognition as well.

items.title: Minerals Commission to take immediate control of Adamus Mine after lease revocation upheld
items.description: The Minerals Commission is set to take immediate administrative control of the Adamus Mine at Salman in the Ellembelle District after the government upheld the revocation of Adamus Resources’ mining lease. The Minister for Lands and Natural Resources, Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah, announced the decision during a working visit to the mine after receiving the report of a Ministerial Review Committee that considered appeals filed by Adamus Resources. According to Mr Buah, the committee examined the concerns raised by the mining company and affirmed most of the breaches identified in the initial assessment of its operations. He subsequently upheld the revocation of the mining lease and directed the Minerals Commission to assume administrative control of the mine with immediate effect. “Following the report of the Minerals Commission to the Chief Inspector of Mines, and with recommendations of the great violation of the Mining Act and mining regulations. A recommendation for revocation of some mining leases was made. “The Ministry agreed with them; there was a petition, and we formed the ministerial review committee. That work has come to an end. As a Minister, I have concluded to uphold the revocation. What that means is that the Minerals Commission should, with immediate effect, take administrative control of this Mine,” he said. The decision follows the government’s earlier revocation of Adamus Resources’ mining lease over alleged breaches of the terms and conditions governing its mining operations. Mr Buah said the review process was undertaken to ensure that the concerns raised by Adamus Resources were fully considered before a final decision was reached. The Minerals Commission is therefore expected to assume administrative control of the mine as the government proceeds with the implementation of the decision.

items.title: Education : Plus de 1.100 nouveaux enseignants en formation de mise à niveau avant leur entrée en fonction
items.description: Lomé, 10 août (ATOP) – Le ministre de l’Education nationale, Mama Omorou a lancé, le lundi 10 août à Lomé, la formation préparatoire de plus de 1.100 nouveaux enseignants, avant leur entrée en fonction dans les établissements scolaires. Cette mise à niveau est organisée dans les sept régions éducatives du Togo pendant deux semaines. La formation vise à préparer les nouveaux enseignants aux exigences de leur métier. Elle porte sur l’éthique et la bonne conduite, les valeurs citoyennes, l’organisation et le fonctionnement de l’Etat, l’administration ainsi que les principes et le financement du budget de l’Etat. L’évaluation est prévue le 19 août. Cent un (101) parmi ces enseignants seront retenus pour assurer l’enseignement de la robotique, du codage, de l’Internet des objets (IoT) et de l’Intelligence artificielle (IA). Le ministre Omorou (au mucro) Pour le ministre Mama Omorou, cette orientation répond à la volonté d’adapter l’école togolaise aux évolutions technologiques. « Nous ne pouvons pas aujourd’hui construire une éducation nationale sans intégrer les technologies nouvelles, notamment la robotique », a-t-il expliqué. Ces enseignants auront la vocation d’intervenir dans les FabLabs, des laboratoires de fabrication numérique où les élèves peuvent mettre en pratique leurs connaissances. Ils pourront y concevoir des objets, programmer de petits logiciels et réaliser différents projets technologiques. Le but est de permettre aux élèves de développer des compétences pratiques pour mieux se préparer aux métiers liés au numérique et aux nouvelles technologies. En parallèle, une formation spécifique est menée au profit de 304 enseignants de mathématiques et de sciences physiques, destinés aux lycées. Pour le gouvernement, ce recrutement doit contribuer à répondre aux besoins en enseignants de sciences dans les établissements secondaires à travers le pays. Le ministre Mama Omorou a invité les nouveaux enseignants à poursuivre leur formation tout au long de leur carrière. Il a exhorté tous les enseignants à maîtriser le numérique, l’IA et les nouvelles technologies pour rester en phase avec les évolutions du monde éducatif. ATOP/MD/MG/DHK

NBA, UNICEF launch N120m legal aid partnership for juvenile offenders
items.description: … as FG pledges support, review of Child’s Rights Act By Ikechukwu Nnochiri ABUJA — The Nigerian Bar Association (NBA) and the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF), on Monday, unveiled a N120 million strategic partnership to guarantee free legal services for juvenile offenders. The development came as the Nigerian Correctional Service (NCS) lamented the absence of detention facilities for children who come into conflict with the law, disclosing that currently, only three Borstal homes are available in the country. An Assistant Controller General of Corrections, Mr. Dabit Timothy, who spoke during the launch of the free legal aid initiative, disclosed that a total of 1,205 children are presently on remand at the three Borstal homes located in Abeokuta, Kaduna, and Ilorin. He, therefore, urged the NBA and the Federal Ministry of Justice to champion the campaign for the provision of Borstal homes in all the states, or at least one facility in each of the six geopolitical zones of the federation. In his remarks, the President of the NBA, Mazi Afam Osigwe, SAN, said the aim of the association’s partnership with UNICEF was to ensure that every child in the country can access justice, protection, and effective legal representation when their rights are violated or they are in conflict with the law, regardless of circumstance or background. He noted that despite significant progress the country has made in advancing child rights through legislation and policy reforms, many children continue to face barriers in accessing justice. “Too often, children who are victims of violence, abuse, exploitation, neglect, trafficking, child marriage, harmful traditional practices, or conflict with the law find themselves without adequate legal support when they need it most. “For these children, lack of legal representation is a failure on our part. As legal practitioners, we occupy a unique position within society. We are not merely interpreters of the law; we are guardians of justice and defenders of the rights of the most vulnerable. “The legal profession carries both a privilege and a responsibility to ensure that those who cannot afford legal services are not excluded from the protection that the law provides. “It is in recognition of the important role lawyers play in promoting social justice in society that those seeking to be elevated to the prestigious rank of Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN) are required to show proof that they have undertaken pro bono legal services to vulnerable or indigent members of society. “This partnership between the NBA and UNICEF seeks to translate that responsibility into concrete action. Through this collaboration, we aim to mobilize lawyers across Nigeria to provide quality pro bono legal representation for children, strengthen referral pathways between justice and child protection actors, build the capacity of legal professionals to handle child-sensitive cases, and promote a justice system that places the best interests of the child at its center. “I therefore call on every branch of the NBA, every law firm, and every legal practitioner to dedicate time, expertise, and resources to providing pro bono legal services for vulnerable children. “I challenge every NBA branch to establish or strengthen pro bono schemes focused on children. I encourage law firms to dedicate a portion of their professional time to child protection cases. “Through this partnership with UNICEF, we will work diligently to mobilize lawyers nationwide, strengthen professional capacity, facilitate referrals, and expand access to quality legal representation for the children who need it most,” Osigwe, SAN, added. The country representative of UNICEF, Wafaa Saeed, described access to justice as a fundamental right that is guaranteed for children. She said the organization’s decision to partner with the NBA was founded on the principle that no child should be denied justice because of a lack of legal representation. “This partnership seeks to ensure that children in contact with the law are protected, represented, and supported throughout the justice process, regardless of their background, location, or economic circumstances. “Across Nigeria, children continue to encounter barriers when interacting with the justice system. Some find themselves in detention without legal representation. Others experience lengthy delays in case management, limited access to diversion opportunities, weak referral systems, and inadequate support services. “These challenges underscore the urgent need for coordinated action and stronger investment in child-friendly justice systems. “At UNICEF, we firmly believe that access to justice is not simply a legal issue. It is a child protection issue, a development issue, and a matter of human dignity. Every child, whether a victim, survivor, witness, or child alleged to have committed an offence, deserves fair treatment, due process, and the opportunity to have their voice heard. “This is why the partnership we launch today is so important. The NBA is uniquely positioned to drive transformational change. “Through its extensive network of legal practitioners, professional structures, and continuing legal education platforms, the NBA can help institutionalize child-sensitive legal representation and establish sustainable pathways for pro bono services across Nigeria,” she added. On his part, the Attorney General of the Federation and Minister of Justice, who was represented by the Director of Criminal Justice and Reforms Department in the Federal Ministry of Justice, Mrs. Leticia Ayoola-Daniels, pledged the Federal Government’s commitment towards strengthening the legal and institutional framework for child justice. The AGF maintained that Nigeria had already established important foundations through the Child’s Rights Act 2003, which, he said, is currently undergoing legislative review to accommodate current realities. The post NBA, UNICEF launch N120m legal aid partnership for juvenile offenders appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Nouveau pont de Kiroti : après la pluie, l’eau stagne et les usagers s’interrogent sur les travaux
items.description: Le nouveau pont de Kiroti, dans la banlieue de Conakry, fait déjà l’objet de critiques. Plusieurs heures après la fin de la pluie, des quantités importantes d’eau stagnent encore sur la chaussée, suscitant l’inquiétude des usagers. Sur le pont, des flaques occupent une partie de la voie et compliquent la circulation. Pour certains usagers, cette situation soulève des interrogations sur la qualité des travaux réalisés sur cet ouvrage censé faciliter la circulation et améliorer les conditions de déplacement. Pour les conducteurs de taxi-moto, les difficultés sont particulièrement importantes. Au guidon de sa moto, Alpha Sylla dit être confronté à cette situation à chaque épisode pluvieux. « Le pont-là nous fatigue beaucoup quand il pleut. Avec la moto, quand tu passes dans l’eau, parfois la moto s’éteint », témoigne-t-il. Selon lui, le problème serait lié à une mauvaise évacuation des eaux de pluie. « Les autorités n’ont qu’à nous aider. Ceux qui ont travaillé ici ont fait un mauvais travail. En principe, l’eau devait passer au fur et à mesure, mais ici, non. Quand il pleut, l’eau reste sur le pont et ici, vous voyez, malgré qu’il n’y a pas de pluie, l’eau est toujours là. C’est bien sûr le nouveau pont de Kiroti », déplore Alpha Sylla. « C’est des milliards qui sont investis » Du côté des autres usagers, la déception est également perceptible. Moustapha Conté reconnaît les efforts consentis par les autorités, mais estime que le suivi des travaux doit être renforcé lorsqu’un ouvrage d’une telle importance est confié à une entreprise. « On est très fiers du travail fait par les autorités. Seulement, nous leur demandons, à chaque fois que le travail est confié à une entreprise, de faire le suivi. C’est des milliards qu’ils investissent pour faire ces ponts. Si le travail n’est pas bien fait, non seulement c’est une perte pour les autorités, mais aussi pour les citoyens », souligne-t-il. Selon lui, l’ampleur du phénomène est difficile à mesurer pour ceux qui n’ont pas été témoins de la situation pendant la pluie. « Si vous voyez la quantité d’eau ici quand il pleut, vous n’allez pas y croire. Nous sommes déçus de ceux qui ont fait ce mauvais travail », ajoute Moustapha Conté. Présente sur les lieux, l’entreprise ayant réalisé les travaux du pont a été approchée par Mediaguinee. Interrogés sur les causes de la stagnation des eaux et sur les éventuelles solutions à mettre en œuvre pour améliorer leur évacuation, les travailleurs rencontrés sur place n’ont pas souhaité répondre aux questions. Pour l’heure, aucune explication technique n’a donc été apportée publiquement sur les raisons de cette accumulation d’eau sur le pont. Sur place, les usagers attendent des réponses et surtout une intervention. Ils craignent que la situation ne se reproduise à chaque pluie et ne perturbe davantage la circulation sur cet ouvrage récemment réalisé. Christine Finda Kamano L’article Nouveau pont de Kiroti : après la pluie, l’eau stagne et les usagers s’interrogent sur les travaux est apparu en premier sur Mediaguinee.com .

items.title: Ganzourgou/Jeunesse : Plusieurs centaines de personnes sensibilisées sur la vie d’un révolutionnaire à Mogtédo
items.description: Burkina/Ganzourgou-Sensibilisation-Jeunesse-Revolution Ganzourgou/Jeunesse : Plusieurs centaines de personnes sensibilisées sur la vie d’un révolutionnaire à Mogtédo Mogtédo, 9 août 2026 (AIB)- Dans le cadre de la célébration de la Journée internationale de la jeunesse, la direction provinciale des sports, de la jeunesse et de l’emploi du Ganzourgou a animé, dimanche 9 août 2026 à Mogtédo, un panel sur la « vie d’un révolutionnaire ». L’activité a réuni plusieurs centaines de participants. Le panel s’est tenu sous le thème de la Journée internationale de la jeunesse 2026, intitulé : « Rôle, responsabilité et engagement de la jeunesse burkinabè dans la construction d’un espace confédéral souverain ». Au cours des échanges, les participants ont été invités à réfléchir sur les valeurs qui doivent guider un révolutionnaire, notamment le patriotisme, l’engagement citoyen, le sacrifice et le travail au service de la nation. Selon le communicateur, Saïdou Badré, être révolutionnaire revient à œuvrer pour le développement de son pays sans nécessairement attendre une contrepartie. Il a rappelé que lors des précédentes périodes révolutionnaires, malgré des moyens limités, les populations avaient contribué à la réalisation de plusieurs infrastructures à travers des actions communautaires. Les échanges ont également porté sur la nécessité, pour les jeunes, de s’approprier les orientations des autorités nationales et de participer activement à leur mise en œuvre. La jeunesse, présentée comme le « fer de lance » de la nation, a été appelée à jouer pleinement son rôle dans la construction d’un Burkina Faso souverain. Pour le directeur provincial des sports, de la jeunesse et de l’emploi du Ganzourgou, Saidou Bruno Ouédraogo, ce panel fait partie des activités prévues par le ministère en charge de la jeunesse dans le cadre de la célébration de la Journée internationale de la jeunesse. Il a indiqué qu’outre ce panel, la direction provinciale en charge de la jeunesse a d’autres activités au programme, notamment une marche de soutien à la Révolution progressiste populaire (RPP), suivie d’une séance d’aérobic, le 11 août, un second panel le 12 août suivi d’un match de football. À travers ces différentes activités, la direction provinciale des sports, de la jeunesse et de l’emploi entend renforcer la sensibilisation, la participation citoyenne et l’engagement des jeunes dans les actions de développement et de construction d’une RPP solide. Agence d’information du Burkina DMO-MS-DNK

items.title: Police in India's Jharkhand fire tear gas, use batons to disperse youth protesters
items.description: Police in eastern India used tear gas, batons and water cannon to disperse thousands of youth protesters as they marched on the state legislature in Jharkhand state on Monday over alleged wrongdoing in civil service examinations, TV footage showed. Students and unemployed youth in Jharkhand, one of India’s poorer states, launched the protests late last month over the alleged wrongdoing, including recruitment test paper leaks. The protest follows weeks-long youth-led demonstrations in the capital, Delhi, also linked to exam paper leaks , which led to the resignation of the country’s Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan last month. Police and paramilitary forces used tear gas , pellet guns and batons in Delhi to scatter some 50,000 youth protesters, some of whom clashed with police. The demonstrations were seen as a reflection of their anger over corruption in education, a lack of opportunities and unemployment. The demands of protesters in Jharkhand include an overhaul of the state’s examination system, cancellation of some tests and an investigation by the federal police. At least six protesters were on hunger strike, including student leader Devendra Nath Mahto, 33, who has been fasting for more than a week. “We want the whole system to change,” Mahto said, as quoted by Indian media, demanding an end to the use of a private company that conducts tests for state civil service. The protest began on July 25 and intensified after thousands gathered at a stadium in the state capital, Ranchi. On Monday, they marched on the state legislature, climbing over police barricades, holding placards, waving the national flag and shouting slogans, amid high security. Some pushed against barricades and scuffled with police, who responded by firing tear gas rounds, using water cannon and beating them with batons, TV footage showed. Police said they had to use mild force after some protesters became violent. “We showed minimal aggression for a really short time because they are just students,” Ranchi city police chief Paras Rana told ANI news agency. “I appeal to everyone to be peaceful and not be violent. Your demands are reaching the government; do not show aggression.” The state government ruled by a regional party opposed to Prime Minister Narendra Modi has held talks with the protesters. It said a majority of their demands had been accepted and that it was open to more talks. Additional input from AFP

items.title: Lacs : Le projet d’accès à l’énergie et l’efficacité énergétique lancé à Aneho
items.description: Aného, 10 août (ATOP) – La deuxième phase du projet « Accès à l’énergie et efficacité énergétique au service d’un développement bas carbone en zones rurales, Togo et Bénin (A3E, II) » a été lancée, le vendredi 7 août à Aného, lors d’un atelier. Ce projet est porté par l’ONG internationale de développement « GERES, la solidarité climatique en action » pour une durée de trois ans. L’objectif est de favoriser un développement bas carbone porté par des groupements de femmes en zones rurales au Bénin et au Togo grâce à des services énergétiques efficaces pour les usages de transformation agricole, notamment du manioc. Les officiels L’initiative permettra aux groupements des femmes de disposer des solutions techniques adaptées d’efficacité énergétique et d’accès à l’énergie pour améliorer la performance économique et environnementale de leurs activités productives dans les territoires ruraux du Togo et du Bénin. Il s’agit de consolider les économies locales dans une perspective inclusive et bas carbone à travers le développement de synergies entre les acteurs de la filière manioc et activités connexes. Le projet A3E, II ambitionne d’assurer la pérennisation de l’intervention à travers le renforcement de capacité des organisations de la société civile et les institutions locales partenaires en renduisant l’émission du dioxyde de carbone. Le projet consiste à accompagner cinquante groupements de la commune Lacs 1 vers l’adoption des foyers améliorés productifs permettant de produire plus et mieux, tout en réduisant la consommation d’énergie. Il va se traduire par l’innovation de l’économie circulaire par l’introduction des combustibles alternatifs au bois, notamment les briquettes de biochar fabriquées à partir des déchets agricoles (noix de coco, palme) en ressources. Le projet prend en compte la professionnalisation et le renforcement des capacités de 216 groupements au Togo et au Bénin au marketing, aux normes de qualité, d’hygiène de sécurité et environnement (QHSE) et à la gestion d’entreprise. Cette deuxième phase accorde 30 % aux jeunes ayant moins de 30 ans en vue de faire de la transformation agroalimentaire une filière d’avenir, attractive et porteuse d’emplois pour les jeunes. Le lancement du projet a été couplé à la restitution des résultats du diagnostic biomasse-énergie de la commune Lacs 1. Cette étude a été réalisée par l’ONG ECO-Bénin dans le cadre du projet A3E. L’adjoint au maire de la commune Lacs 1, Agossou Kangni Kouévi, a exhorté les bénéficiaires du projet à plus de responsabilité, de détermination, de loyauté et de discipline en vue de sa réussite. Le représentant pays GERES Bénin-Togo par intérim, Hugues Ekpinda a pris part à la cérémonie de lancement. ATOP/DK/MD/BV

items.title: PTI leadership, TTAP on board for September 27 long march to Islamabad: Sohail Afridi
items.description: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi on Monday said that PTI’s political leadership and its ally, the Tehreek Tahaffuz-i-Ayeen Pakistan (TTAP), were on board with the call for a long march on September 27. Speaking on Geo News’ programme ‘Capital Talk’, CM Afridi said, “The PTI’s political leadership across the country and its ally, the TTAP, are all on board with the long march, and they collectively agreed on September 27 as the date for it.” Responding to a question about Imran Khan’s sister Aleema Khan’s reservations over the date, he said she was a “non-political individual” and would agree to the date once the PTI apprised her of all the facts and figures. CM Afridi also denied allegations by a PTI member currently residing outside Pakistan that he had met Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi before finalising the date for the long march. “That allegation was rubbish. At the time of the alleged meeting, I was at KP House in Islamabad, contrary to the claim that I had met him in Peshawar,” he said. In response to a question, CM Afridi also rejected the impression of a communication gap between the party’s leadership and workers. Talking about the ‘D-Chowk, D-Chowk’ slogans during the recent Peshawar rally, he said institutions that were not granting political space to the PTI should understand that the party’s leadership had taken on a great burden by seeking to resolve issues through mutual understanding. “However, not just in KP but across Pakistan, particularly the youth, no one will be able to contain them when they come out on Sept 27, because I can see passion and a ray of light in their eyes,” the chief minister said. During the interview, the KP chief minister also criticised the federal government led by Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif for economic inefficiency and bad governance. He said that if he met PTI founder Imran Khan at Adiala jail and was instructed to defer the Sept 27 date for the long march, he would agree. CM Afridi added that he would also follow Imran’s instructions if asked to pave the way for talks. More to follow

Haho/Fête des retrouvailles « Agbéza » : Les fils de Dalia Bégbé et d’Atchavé prônent le vivre-ensemble
items.description: Notsé, 10 août (ATOP) – Les cadres, natifs et sympathisants des cantons de Dalia Bégbé et d’Atchavé, dans la commune Haho 1, ont célébré leur fête des retrouvailles dénommée « Agbéza », le samedi 8 août dans la localité. La célébration a été placée sous le thème « Le vivre-ensemble, socle de nos traditions et moteur du développement du secteur de Dalia ». Elle a été marquée par des moments de réflexion, de partage et de convivialité. Les prestations de jeunes La manifestation a été ponctuée d’une conférence publique autour du thème retenu, du don d’un ordinateur de bureau au CEG de Dalia, ainsi que de prestations de groupes folkloriques. Des opérations de salubrité publique, des jeux récréatifs et un match de football entre les jeunes de Dalia et de Kplé ont également animé la journée. La fête vise à renforcer les liens entre les filles et fils des deux cantons et à valoriser leur patrimoine. Elle encourage également la mobilisation des populations autour des défis locaux, notamment l’assainissement, l’éducation et l’employabilité des jeunes. Le préfet de Haho, Colonel Gnakou Alowègnim, a exhorté les cadres, natifs et sympathisants de Dalia Bégbé et d’Atchavé à poursuivre leur engagement dans cette dynamique de développement participatif. Don d’ordinateurs Les chefs des cantons de Dalia Bégbé et d’Atchavé, respectivement Togbui Amégnona Adako II et Togbui Akakpo Folidje ont appelé les populations à renforcer le vivre-ensemble et la paix, considérés comme des conditions essentielles au développement. Pour le président du comité d’organisation, Koukui Kodjo, la célébration d’« Agbéza » traduit la volonté de fédérer les actions des filles et fils des deux cantons autour de la promotion du droit à l’éducation des enfants, de la sensibilisation au civisme et à la citoyenneté, ainsi que du renforcement des partenariats entre les acteurs du développement. Il a fait savoir que cette rencontre constitue à la fois une expression de solidarité, un devoir de mémoire et un engagement en faveur de la jeunesse et d’un avenir meilleur pour les communautés. ATOP/YM/AO/BV

items.title: Le Burkina renforce son réseau électrique avec une centrale thermique de 25 MW
items.description: Après Pabré et Bobo-Dioulasso, Koudougou, dans le centre-ouest du Burkina Faso accueille à son tour une nouvelle infrastructure de production d’électricité. Le ministre burkinabè de l’Énergie, des Mines et des Carrières, Yacouba Zabré Gouba a procédé, ce lundi 10 août 2026, à l’inauguration d’une centrale thermique d’une capacité de 25 mégawatts, destinée à renforcer l’offre énergétique nationale et à mieux desservir la région de Nando. Le Burkina Faso poursuit ses efforts pour accroître ses capacités de production électrique. À Koudougou, dans la région de Nando, dans le centre-ouest burkinabè, une nouvelle centrale thermique de 25 MW vient d’être mise en service. L’infrastructure a été inaugurée, ce lundi 10 août 2026, par le ministre de l’Énergie, des Mines et des Carrières, Yacouba Zabré Gouba. Centrale électrique à Koudougou Composée de 28 groupes électrogènes, la centrale a été réalisée en 347 jours dans le cadre d’un partenariat avec l’entreprise libanaise BUTEC Power Generation. Le coût de réalisation de l’ouvrage s’élève à 15 397 403 948,787 FCFA. Cette nouvelle unité de production d'énergie vient ainsi accroître les capacités électriques du Burkina Faso. Elle devrait également contribuer à une meilleure couverture des besoins énergétiques de la région de Nando, tout en participant à la déconcentration de la production électrique, jusque-là fortement concentrée autour des pôles de Ouagadougou et de Bobo-Dioulasso. Le ministre chargé de l’Énergie, Yacouba Zabré Gouba Pour le ministre en charge de l'Energie, Yacouba Zabré Gouba, la mise en service de cette centrale traduit la volonté des autorités de rapprocher davantage la production énergétique des zones de consommation. «Cette centrale de Koudougou constitue une étape importante dans le renforcement de notre capacité de production et dans notre volonté de donner davantage de capacités énergétiques aux régions», a-t-il souligné. Visite guidée dans les locaux de' la nouvelle centrale thermique de Koudougou Le ministre Gouba a également inscrit cette réalisation dans la dynamique de recherche d’une plus grande autonomie énergétique du pays. «Notre ambition est de renforcer progressivement l’autonomie énergétique du Burkina Faso en développant les capacités de production et en rapprochant l’électricité des populations et des activités économiques. Plusieurs de ces genres de réalisation continueront de voir le jour pour le bonheur de l'ensemble des Burkinabè», a-t-il déclaré. L'administrateur général de Power BUTEC Generation, Sleiman Abi Ghanem Du côté de BUTEC Power Generation, la satisfaction est également de mise. L’administrateur général de l’entreprise, Sleiman Abi Ghanem, a exprimé sa reconnaissance aux autorités burkinabè pour la confiance accordée à son groupe dans la réalisation de cet ouvrage. «Nous exprimons notre reconnaissance aux autorités du Burkina Faso pour la confiance accordée à BUTEC dans la réalisation de cette centrale», a déclaré M. Ghanem, soulignant que la présence de l’entreprise dans le pays ne se limite pas aux seules considérations commerciales. Des autorités coutumières à l'inauguration de la centrale thermique de koudougou L’administrateur général a assuré que BUTEC entend rester engagée aux côtés du Burkina Faso et attentive aux préoccupations des populations. «Au-delà du business, BUTEC est engagée au Burkina Faso et reste soucieuse de contribuer au bien-être des populations», a-t-il affirmé. La nouvelle centrale électrique inauguré à Koudougou Avec cette nouvelle centrale de 25 MW, Koudougou devient ainsi un nouveau maillon du dispositif national de production d’électricité. Une réalisation qui s’inscrit dans la dynamique de renforcement de la souveraineté énergétique du Burkina Faso, à travers une production davantage répartie sur le territoire national. Par Valentin SOMANDE L’article Le Burkina renforce son réseau électrique avec une centrale thermique de 25 MW est apparu en premier sur Wakat Séra .

items.title: Amérique du Sud : la Colombie frappée par un séisme de magnitude 7,4
items.description: La Colombie a ete touchee ce 10 août, a 7h34 heure locale, par un seisme de magnitude 7,4 sur l'echelle de Richter, d'apres le Service geologique colombien (SGC). Selon cette meme source , l'epicentre se situe a San Jose del Palmar, dans le departement de Chocó, qui longe le littoral de l'ocean Pacifique, a une profondeur de 82 kilometres. Les secousses ont ete ressenties dans la capitale Bogota, mais egalement dans celles de l'equateur et du Panama voisins. Des degâts sont rapportes dans les villes de Manizales, Pereira ainsi que Cali. Le maire de cette derniere, la troisieme ville du pays, a fait etat de « dommages importants », qui sont en cours d'evaluation a l'aide de drones, avec des personnes « coincees » sous des « structures effondrees ». BREAKING: A 7.4 magnitude earthquake has struck the San José del Palma region of Colombia, with the mayor of Choco stating that, "there are injuries and severe damage to buildings, and we are concerned about aftershocks" pic.twitter.com/ZkZaOtunM9 — StrandenOSINT (@StrandenOSINT) August 10, 2026 De nombreuses videos, particulierement impressionnantes, circulant sur les reseaux sociaux, montrent Cali parsemee de nuages ​​de poussiere ou encore des structures malmenees . D'eventuelles reponses redoutees Parmi ces dernieres figurent la cathedrale Notre-Dame-du-Rosaire a Manizales ainsi que des infrastructures aeroportuaires . items.title: 2Baba, Annie re-follow each other over a year after split
items.description: By Caleb Ayemere Legendary music star Innocent Idibia, popularly known as 2Baba, and his estranged wife, Annie, have sparked fresh reconciliation rumors after refollowing each other on Instagram. According to online checks by Vanguard, the former couple, who had previously unfollowed each other on the platform, restored their digital connection on Monday. The social media activity has fueled widespread speculation among fans, with many interpreting the move as a sign of mending relations following their high-profile split. Neither 2Baba nor Annie has issued an official statement confirming a reconciliation or a change in their marital status. The development comes over a year after 2Baba publicly announced in January 2025 that the couple had separated and were filing for divorce. Though the initial announcement was briefly deleted due to claims of a compromised account, the singer later confirmed he was responsible for the statement. He subsequently married Edo State lawmaker Natasha Osawaru. The pair’s high-profile history dates back to the early years of 2Baba’s career, highlighted by Annie’s appearance in his iconic “African Queen” music video. The couple married in 2013 across two ceremonies in Akwa Ibom State and Dubai, and later renewed their vows in 2023 for their 10th anniversary. Despite undergoing public crises over the years, their latest online interaction has renewed discussions among observers regarding their current relationship status. The post 2Baba, Annie re-follow each other over a year after split appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Les parlementaires de Kloto échangent avec les populations de la zone Blifou sur le développement
items.description: Kpalimé, 9 août (ATOP) – Les parlementaires de Kloto ont échangé, le dimanche 9 août à Blifou, 24 km au nord-ouest de Kpalimé, avec les populations de la zone Blifou, dans la commune Kloto 2, sur leurs préoccupations et les priorités de développement de leur milieu. Cette rencontre s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une démarche de proximité engagée par les élus afin de rester à l’écoute des populations et de mieux cerner leurs besoins. Les échanges ont permis aux représentants des différentes localités de présenter, aux parlementaires, les difficultés auxquelles leurs communautés sont confrontées. Les principales doléances portent sur l’électrification des villages de la montagne, la réhabilitation des axes routiers, notamment les tronçons Blifou-Ewekopé, Lavié-Agodè et Blifou-Tchadomé, ainsi que la construction de forage à Atsratsa et Dzogagbé. Les Participants Les populations ont également sollicité la construction d’un dispensaire équipé, au profit des habitants d’Agodè, Tsavagna, Dzogagbé et Atsratsa. Elles ont, en outre, plaidé pour la réhabilitation des salles de classe de l’Ecole primaire publique (EPP) de Blifou, qui abrite le centre d’écrit du Certificat d’étude du premier degré (CEPD) des écoles de la zone montagneuse. D’autres préoccupations concernent la construction de marchés destinés à faciliter la commercialisation des produits agricoles, l’amélioration des infrastructures scolaires et sanitaires, ainsi que l’accès aux différents services sociaux de base, ont été évoquées. Les députés Kwassi Martin, Yovo Komlan, Mme Sabine Grüner et la sénatrice, Dr Atutonu Amah ont, dans l’immédiat, annoncé la réalisation, dans les prochains jours, d’un forage photovoltaïque au profit des populations de la zone. Ils ont appelé les populations à préserver la cohésion sociale, à privilégier le dialogue et à s’impliquer davantage dans les initiatives communautaires. Les parlementaires ont également promis de continuer à porter leurs préoccupations auprès des autorités compétentes. Le député Kwassi a déclaré que des initiatives similaires seront poursuivies dans les communes Kloto 1 et Kloto 3. ATOP/AYH/HKM/BV

items.title: Minister upholds revocation of Adamus Resources mining leases following independent committee review
items.description: The Minister for Lands and Natural Resources, Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah, has upheld the revocation of the mining leases held by Adamus Resources Limited following the submission of the final report by the Inter-Ministerial Committee tasked with reviewing the company’s petition against the initial decision. The Minister’s final determination brings to a close a review process that was initiated after the Minister, acting on the recommendation of the Minerals Commission, revoked the Akango, Salman and Nkroful mining leases of Adamus Resources Limited in April 2026. The initial revocation followed a series of inspections conducted by the Inspectorate Division of the Minerals Commission which uncovered sustained and material breaches of the Minerals and Mining Act, 2006 (Act 703) and its subsidiary legislations. The Minerals Commission’s initial investigations established multiple violations by Adamus Resources Limited including the unauthorised assignment of mineral rights. The company subleased portions of its concessions to foreign nationals for independent mining operations without the prior written approval of the Minister, contrary to section 14(1) of Act 703, and mining outside demarcated and permitted areas without an approved Operating Permit from the Chief Inspector of Mines, in contravention of Regulations 200(1)(b) and 200(1)(d) of the Minerals and Mining (Licensing) Regulations, 2012 (L.I. 2176). The Commission also established that Adamus had failed to obtain requisite environmental and forestry approvals from the Environmental Protection Authority before operations commenced in the assigned areas, contrary to section 18 of Act 703. Adamus also failed to cooperate with the Interim Management Committee (IMC) established to oversee the mine. The review committee found that Adamus deliberately concealed information and provided misleading data. It also uncovered additional defaults: US$2.56 million in unpaid mineral rights fees, GHS 86.8 million in unpaid royalties, GHS 290.5 million in tax arrears, and unexplained variances in gold exports. The company transferred US$224 million to related parties abroad between 2020 and 2024, and environmental bonds remain only partially fulfilled. Following this decision, the Minister and officials of the Ministry and the Minerals Commission embarked on a working visit to the mine site to engage key stakeholders, including workers of the mine. During the visit, the Minister assured that the Minerals Commission will ensure uninterrupted operations until a further decision by government has been announced. Hon. Buah has also indicated his intention to secure an order that Adamus fully and promptly fulfils its royalty, tax and other financial liabilities to the Government of Ghana.

items.title: Importations fictives : les douanes traquent des transferts de 370 millions de dollars
items.description: Les éléments de la brigade nationale des douanes ont élargi leurs investigations sur les activités d’un réseau impliqué dans des opérations d’importation suspectes. Les premières investigations ont révélé de forts indices laissant penser au transfert frauduleux de sommes considérables à l’étranger au moyen de factures commerciales chinoises et malaisiennes, soupçonnées d’être falsifiées, utilisées pour justifier des transferts en devises au profit d’exportateurs étrangers. Selon des sources bien informées citées par Hespress, les investigations des services douaniers ont permis de cibler les transactions de cinq entreprises dont l’implication dans des opérations d’importation fictives a été établie. Ces opérations auraient permis de transférer plus de 370 millions de dollars vers les comptes de prétendus exportateurs en Chine et en Malaisie sur une période d’à peine un an et demi. Il est apparu, parallèlement, que les chiffres d’affaires de ces entreprises ne correspondaient ni à l’ampleur de leurs activités commerciales ni à la valeur des importations déclarées. Les mêmes sources ont indiqué que les contrôleurs se sont appuyés sur des comparaisons techniques entre les données déclarées par les entreprises concernées auprès des services douaniers et des bases de données internationales consacrées aux prix des marchandises et aux transactions commerciales. Cette méthode leur a permis de relever d’importants écarts entre les montants figurant sur les factures et les prix réellement pratiqués par les fabricants et les fournisseurs. Ces résultats ont renforcé les soupçons concernant le recours à la surfacturation des importations afin de transférer illicitement des montants supplémentaires en devises à l’étranger, sous couvert d’opérations commerciales légales. Les investigations portent également sur l’identité des exportateurs chinois et malaisiens ayant bénéficié des transferts en question. Les enquêtes ont révélé que les noms de plusieurs d’entre eux figuraient sur des « listes noires » établies par des administrations douanières et des organismes de contrôle étrangers, notamment dans des pays asiatiques et européens, en raison de soupçons antérieurs concernant leurs liens avec des réseaux spécialisés dans la facturation fictive et la manipulation de la valeur des échanges commerciaux. Les mêmes sources ont souligné que cet élément a conduit les responsables du contrôle douanier à élargir leurs investigations, en étroite coordination avec les services de l’Office des changes, afin d’identifier les bénéficiaires réels des fonds transférés et de déterminer si les entreprises marocaines concernées ne seraient que des sociétés-écrans utilisées pour effectuer des transferts au profit d’autres parties, en échange de commissions. Dans ce contexte, les services de contrôle douanier se concentrent également sur le parcours des fonds, depuis leur sortie des comptes bancaires au Maroc jusqu’à leur arrivée à l’étranger. Ils examinent notamment la nature des contrats commerciaux, les documents d’expédition, les factures, les certificats d’origine et les documents de dédouanement, afin de vérifier l’existence réelle des marchandises correspondant aux transferts effectués et de déterminer si certaines opérations n’ont existé que sur le papier, sans être accompagnées d’importations réelles. De telles pratiques pourraient constituer une violation de la réglementation des changes et des lois encadrant le commerce extérieur. À noter que les établissements bancaires sont tenus, conformément à la réglementation en vigueur, de conserver l’ensemble des documents liés aux opérations de financement des importations, notamment les factures, contrats, documents de transport et justificatifs de paiement. Ces documents doivent être mis à la disposition des contrôleurs de l’Office des changes et des autorités compétentes lorsque les opérations de contrôle l’exigent, afin de vérifier la légalité des transferts et leur conformité aux dispositions légales et réglementaires. Les sources de Hespress s’attendent à ce que les investigations en cours permettent d’ouvrir de nouveaux dossiers après l’analyse de nouvelles données financières et commerciales. Cette perspective intervient notamment en raison des soupçons concernant l’existence de réseaux qui exploiteraient des entreprises aux activités limitées ou récemment créées pour conclure des opérations d’importation fictives avec des exportateurs étrangers, dans le but de faire sortir du Royaume des sommes se chiffrant en milliards de centimes, grâce à la manipulation des valeurs déclarées sur les factures et à la surfacturation des marchandises. The post Importations fictives : les douanes traquent des transferts de 370 millions de dollars appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: UK radio broke rules in announcing King’s death
items.description: A community radio station breached the rules after accidentally announcing the death of King Charles III in a May broadcast, a UK watchdog said on Monday. Radio Caroline, a former pirate radio that now mostly plays rock music, apologised in May after airing messages falsely announcing the monarch’s death. One of the messages had said “we have suspended our normal programmes until further notice as a mark of respect following the passing of His Majesty King Charles III”. The national anthem was then played, followed by around 16 minutes of silence before the regular programme resumed. The presenter apologised 30 minutes after the messages were initially triggered, Ofcom said. The regulator, which received two complaints about the broadcast, said the “very significant inaccuracy” and the “considerable length of time” taken to acknowledge the error breached two of its rules. One requires news reports to be accurate and impartial. The other requires significant mistakes to be acknowledged and corrected on air promptly. Radio Caroline told Ofcom the error occurred when a member of staff accessed sound files pre-recorded in the event of the monarch’s death while carrying out maintenance on the studio computer, as the programme was being streamed remotely. The staff member played the files “out of curiosity”, which stopped the stream from the presenter’s remote location and broadcast the files on air. The person then reportedly “panicked and left the premises” after realising what had happened, according to the Ofcom statement. Radio Caroline said the remote presenter “would not realise that they had gone ‘off air’ unless they were monitoring their output via an internet monitor.” The presenter, believing they were still on air, was not actively monitoring their phone and did not immediately respond to calls from people at the station who had noticed the error, the report said. The station said the person who played the files had been “reprimanded” and had “apologised”. It added the pre-recorded files had now been removed from the studio computer. lmc/jkb/fg The post UK radio broke rules in announcing King’s death appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Balé : Le PDS lance officiel les Journées nationales de lutte anti-larvaire pour lutter contre le paludisme
items.description: Burkina/Balé-Journée-Anti-Larvaire Balé : Le PDS lance officiel les Journées nationales de lutte anti-larvaire pour lutter contre le paludisme Fara, 8 août 2026 (AIB) – Le camarade Aloys Ouango, Président de la délégation spéciale (PDS) de la commune de Fara a lancé officiellement les Journées nationales de lutte anti-larvaire (JNLAV) sur le site du marché central, le samedi 8 août 2026. Le PDS était accompagné par les membres des corps constitués, la veille citoyenne, le major du CSPS de Fara, les Forces de défense et de sécurité (FDS) et des Volontaires pour la défense de la patrie (VDP), les groupements et associations. Le lancement a été mené sous le signe du patrimoine et de la citoyenneté et a consisté à une sensibilisation des populations sur les conséquences néfastes des gîtes larvaires suivi de conseils pratiques. L'équipe du jour a parcouru les grandes artères du marché central et de la ville. L'activité a consisté à identifier les gîtes larvaires, les dépôts d'ordures et à conscientiser les riverains sur les dangers qu'ils courent. Pour le major du CSPS, les dangers liés à ces gîtes sont légion notamment, la mortalité infantile et maternelle dues au paludisme. Pour lui, le paludisme est causé par les moustiques qui se reproduisant dans ces nids et aussi les maladies diarrhéiques pour absence d'hygiène. Afin d'éviter toutes ces maladies, chaque citoyen doit rendre son cadre de vie toujours propre, a-t-il dit. Le PDS a félicité les populations sorties nombreuses pour cette activité. En effet, les plus hautes autorités ont voulu la tenue de ces journées afin d'aider les populations à se protéger contre certaines maladies qui engendrent plusieurs dégâts sociaux et ralentissent ainsi les actions de développement du pays, a ajouté le major. « Je vous exhorte à respecter les consignes de santé en veillant à la propriété des habitations et des lieux publics », a-t-il ajouté. « Par conséquent, curons les caniveaux, balayons nos rues, éliminons les déchets, préservons notre cadre de vie car c'est cela le patriotisme et la citoyenneté. Chaque geste compte pour notre santé et notre avenir », a-t-il conseillé. Agence d'Information du Burkina. EK-DNK

items.title: AKSA Energy deal: Bribery offences not time-barred, assets can be recovered – Ayikoi Otoo
items.description: Former Attorney General and Minister for Justice, Ayikoi Otoo, says public officials found to have received bribes in connection with the AKSA Energy deal could still face prosecution, even if the alleged offences occurred more than a decade ago. Speaking on Joy FM’s Midday News , Mr Otoo said the key consideration would be whether there is sufficient evidence to establish that an offence was committed. “I’m not aware that there is time limitation for crimes. So long as a crime is committed, while we are caught, it can be prosecuted,” he said. His comments follow the conviction of former Tema Oil Refinery Managing Director, Asante Kwaku Berko, by a United States court over a bribery scheme linked to a power plant deal involving Ghana. The conviction has renewed calls for Ghanaian authorities to investigate individuals who may have been implicated in the alleged scheme. Mr Otoo also said the state could potentially recover assets or financial benefits linked to corruption if wrongdoing is established. He explained that a court could order the confiscation of assets and seek to recover funds or benefits that the state may have lost as a result of the alleged corruption. “I mean, a court can order that it is committed to confiscate the assets and make sure that we recover whatever we have lost, or recover some benefit, recover at least whatever we have lost,” he stated. The former Attorney General said the courts could, where the applicable legal requirements are satisfied, make orders requiring an individual to refund money or for property connected to the proceeds of an offence to be confiscated. “I don’t think there will be anything wrong with the judge making an order that you should refund, or that your property be confiscated under the Anti-Money Laundering Act and all those things,” he added.

items.title: Pak-Saudi-Turkiye defence pact ‘entirely for defensive purposes’, not aggression: PM Shehbaz
items.description: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Monday affirmed that the recently signed Makkah Joint Defence Agreement was “entirely for defensive purposes”, and not for any aggression. The joint defence agreement, signed on August 7 between Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye, aims to strengthen collective deterrence and empowers its signatory states to treat an attack against one of them as an attack against all of them. Addressing the federal cabinet on Monday, PM Shehbaz recalled that he, Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan signed the pact in Makkah on Friday. The prime minister stressed that the objective of the pact is to “promote peace, progress, and prosperity in the region”. “Its purpose is definitely not that any aggression occurs. It is entirely for defensive purposes, for peace, tranquillity and progress in the region,” he affirmed. “I believe this agreement is a source of strength not just among these three countries, but for the entire Muslim ummah,” he noted. PM Shehbaz particularly felicitated Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar as well as Chief of Defence Forces (CDF) Field Marshal Asim Munir on the signing of the agreement. Efforts for the joint defence pact had been underway for “many years and materialised this Friday”, the prime minister said. He noted that while Pakistan and Saudi Arabia had already entered the “ Strategic Mutual Defence Agreement ” in September 2025, Islamabad and Ankara also had “arrangements for decades” between them. PM Shehbaz recalled that the Pakistani nation and the army had been honoured to “defend the world’s holiest places” of Makkah and Madina for years along with the Saudi forces. “Last year, with Allah’s grace, this arrangement was officially recognised so that a proper agreement was signed. Friday’s agreement is another extension of it, with a trilateral agreement signed.” In a statement issued by the Foreign Office earlier in the day, Dar felicitated the nation on the agreement’s signing. He reiterated his comments from Sunday wherein he said the pact was defensive in nature and not directed against any country. Dar also noted that the term of treating an attack on one of them as an attack against all three was “consistent with the inherent right of individual and collective self-defence under Article 51 of the United Nations Charter”. The Makkah Joint Defence Agreement has been hailed by the 57-member Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) as an “important strategic step”. Kuwait , Bahrain and Somalia are among the countries that have welcomed it. Iran’s comments also took a rather positive tone, stressing its stance of pursuing “security mechanisms based on cooperation between regional countries”. ‘Once in power, AJK govt will offer dialogue to those willing’ Speaking on Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK), PM Shehbaz favoured dialogue with protesters who have been at odds with the authorities over the 12 seats reserved for refugees and other issues, leading to a tense situation in the region for the past two months. He said that once the new government comes to power in AJK — with PML-N already claiming a two-thirds majority — the matter of continuing talks with the protesters “will progress”. The prime minister declared that those “who only want to cause anarchy will not be allowed to do so, but those who want to peacefully and patiently discuss the situation, the new government will provide a chance for that”. “In any respected society, no permission can be given for lawlessness. If there is any demand or any matters, they should be resolved through talks at a table,” he said. PM Shehbaz went on to say that the government had “clear evidence that those who purposefully worsened the situation there were working on the directives of the enemy”. He recalled that despite that, the government had held a multi-party conference in Muzaffarabad before the elections, with only one political party being absent — apparently referring to the PTI which has boycotted the polls. “Every aspect was discussed there, and […] those who wanted refugee seats to be changed, reduced or abolished were advised to let the elections go on as planned and bring forward their case in the new assembly,” he said, adding that this would resolve the matter as per the constitution of AJK. “All matters were settled, but they remained adamant on this and needlessly insisted, which unfortunately worsened the situation,” the prime minister said. Speaking about the ongoing elections in AJK, PM Shehbaz asserted that Kashmiris have “overwhelmingly voted” for his PML-N. The PML-N has so far bagged 24 seats out of a total 45 — nine from Mirpur polls held on July 27 and 15 in the second phase comprising Muzaffarabad Division and the 12 refugee seats. The third phase of elections in Poonch Division began today . The prime minister noted that based on the results from Mirpur and Muzaffarabad divisions, along with the seats reserved for refugees from India-held Kashmir, the PML-N has “almost established a majority”. “This vote is a vote of trust in Mian Nawaz Sharif and for his leadership. I am hopeful that once we set up a government there, under his leadership, AJK will once again set out on the journey to progress and prosperity,” he said, thanking those who voted for his party. ‘Terrorists being annihilated day and night’ At the federal cabinet meeting, PM Shehbaz also touched upon the issue of terrorism in the country and mentioned the lives lost in recent terrorist attacks. He noted that terrorists escalated their activities in “some areas of Pakistan in the past few days”. The premier recalled the August 2 Swat suicide bombing that claimed 17 lives and the martyrdom of Deputy Superintendent of Police Diyar Khan in an attack on a Hangu police checkpost. He paid tribute to the sacrifices of the personnel, including Captain Hamza Akram and Major Hafiz Ihsan Elahi, who were martyred during operations in Hangu and North Waziristan , respectively. The prime minister affirmed that “ Fitna Al Khawarij are being annihilated day and night”, referring to terrorists affiliated with the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP). “These sacrifices will not go in vain and will bear fruition. One day will come when Pakistan will once again be free from terrorism and will move rapidly towards peace and progress,” PM Shehbaz said. The prime minister also expressed his condolences over the death of PML-N MNA Malik Muhammad Iqbal Channar, describing him as a “longtime friend”. “He was a person who was a supporter in bad times,” he said, adding that he and PML-N President Nawaz Sharif knew Channar since 1985. The cabinet also prayed for the elevated ranks of the martyrs and Channar.

items.title: Power workers oppose planned private-sector participation in ECG and NEDCo
items.description: The Public Utilities Workers Union (PUWU) has criticised the government’s decision to appoint a transaction adviser to facilitate private-sector participation in the Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) and Northern Electricity Distribution Company (NEDCo). The union says the move amounts to a breach of the mutual trust and confidence that has characterised its engagements with the Ministry of Energy and Green Transition. In a statement dated 3 August 2026 and signed by its General Secretary, Timothy Nyam, PUWU said its last interaction with the ministry was to submit an alternative proposal to private-sector participation in ECG. The union said it had submitted a detailed position paper on the proposed privatisation of ECG and NEDCo, but the ministry was yet to acknowledge receipt. It said the government had meanwhile appointed a transaction adviser who was actively holding meetings and advancing what PUWU described as the government’s privatisation agenda. PUWU also said the Finance Minister’s budget statement had reaffirmed government’s intention and timelines to privatise ECG, without considering the representation and position paper submitted by the union. Union’s concerns PUWU said its position paper highlighted several challenges affecting ECG and NEDCo. These include political interference in management and procurement processes, the appointment of non-technical board members, uncoordinated activities under the Self-Help Electrification Programme, foreign exchange losses, the recent reclassification of bulk customers, and what it described as a lack of accountability and transparency across the energy supply chain. The union said it had proposed practical solutions aimed at improving the operational efficiency, financial viability and long-term sustainability of the two state-owned utilities. It called for competent boards of directors and managing directors with clearly defined performance targets, the depoliticisation of management structures and greater accountability throughout the energy value chain. PUWU rejects privatisation PUWU said historical shortcomings of privatisation efforts in Ghana and elsewhere in Africa showed that transferring public utilities such as ECG and NEDCo to private investors in the name of private-sector participation could worsen existing inefficiencies. According to the union, such arrangements could increase costs to consumers, reduce access to essential services and undermine national sovereignty, employment, labour rights and energy security. PUWU is therefore calling for ECG and NEDCo to remain under public ownership and control. The union says this would help guarantee affordable and equitable access to electricity, preserve national sovereignty, protect jobs and support broader socio-economic development. Rather than pursuing privatisation as a quick-fix solution, PUWU is calling for a comprehensive reform strategy to strengthen the two utilities. It has reiterated its strongest opposition to any attempt to privatise ECG and NEDCo, either wholly or in part. The union said that, together with affiliates of the Trades Union Congress, it was prepared to mobilise “every legitimate means” to resist any policy seeking to transfer ownership or control of the strategic national assets to private interests. Despite its opposition to privatisation, PUWU said it remained ready to partner the government and other relevant stakeholders to revitalise ECG, NEDCo and the wider energy sector for the benefit of Ghana and Ghanaians.

Police arrest four suspected cult members in Lagos
items.description: … Recover locally made pistol, live ammunition By Esther Onyegbula LAGOS — The Lagos State Police Command has arrested four suspected members of the Aiye Confraternity cult group in Mushin, following intelligence linking one of the suspects to alleged killings in the area and other parts of the state. The suspects were also said to have led police operatives to recover a locally made Beretta pistol and one 9mm live ammunition. The Police Public Relations Officer, Lagos State Command, SP Abimbola Adebisi, disclosed this in a statement on Sunday. According to her, the arrest followed credible intelligence on the activities of cult groups in Mushin, which prompted operatives of the Violent Crime Response Unit (VCRU) to commence an operation in the area. She said the first suspect arrested, Irawo Moshod, allegedly admitted to being a former chairman of the Aiye Confraternity. Adebisi said Moshod made useful disclosures during interrogation, including an alleged admission of involvement in several killings in Mushin and other parts of Lagos State. She said: “During investigation, the suspect admitted to being a former chairman of the Aiye Confraternity cult group and made useful disclosures regarding the activities of the group, including his alleged involvement in several killings within Mushin and other parts of Lagos State.” Acting on information allegedly provided by Moshod, the operatives proceeded to Idi-Oro, Mushin, where they recovered the locally made Beretta pistol and the 9mm live ammunition. The police subsequently arrested three other suspected members of the group — Abayomi James, 29; Farouq Bankole, 28; and Steven Sunday, 19 — at Aganran by Ojuwoye. The command said the three suspects admitted to being members of the Aiye Confraternity and allegedly disclosed that the recovered firearm was obtained from one Rilwan, whom they identified as a senior member of the group. The four suspects are currently in police custody and assisting with investigations, while efforts are ongoing to arrest other suspected members of the group. Commending the VCRU operatives, the Commissioner of Police, Lagos State Command, CP Tijani Fatai, described the operation as proactive and intelligence-driven. Fatai reaffirmed the command’s commitment to dismantling criminal networks and ensuring the safety of residents across the state. He warned cultists and other criminal elements to desist from their activities or face the full weight of the law. The command also urged residents to report suspicious activities through its emergency lines for prompt police response. The post Police arrest four suspected cult members in Lagos appeared first on Vanguard News .
